description.purpose: Turns a topology snapshot into ONE view: a component tree of hives, edges and cells, plus the four component definitions it is written in, and the browser half that routes the lines and owns the drag.
description.use_when: Inside a colony-view hive. It answers a snapshot and nothing else, in a single pass, because a view is a statement rather than a patch.
description.not_in_scope: It never learns where a box ended up. Each cell's tree entry declares keep on its two coordinates, so a display that already holds the object leaves them out of an update and the browser's value stands; there is no read-back and no marker to reconcile. It also draws nothing the snapshot does not hold.
examples: a snapshot of nodes and edges becomes one view on the view lane
a drag lands in the display's own database and survives the next tick untouched
